requirement.statement: Halfcode SHALL integrate canonical profile-aware Flow definitions through AppBundle registration, VFS resolution, Scope runtime binding, and explicit lifecycle dependencies without owning Flow grammar or scheduler semantics.

case.given: an InstantFlow, WorkFlow, or BizProcess unit is registered in an AppBundle
case.when: Halfcode loads and materializes the unit
case.then: the unit SHALL retain the unique upstream FlowContract and its input/output type references

case.given: an InstantFlow calls another CtrlFlow product by canonical product URI
case.then: Halfcode SHALL resolve the target definition and target VFS code in the same AppBundle

case.given: a WorkFlow or BizProcess calls a durable child
case.when: the parent starts and later refreshes
case.then: Halfcode SHALL use explicit child lifecycle dependencies and SHALL leave child facts in the upstream stores

case.given: the same Flow definition is visible in parent and child Scopes
case.when: each Scope invokes its bound handle
case.then: dynamic code SHALL receive that Scope's runtime object while sharing no implicit global runtime
